# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_MEANREV_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
Price tends to revert to VWAP after an early opening range break, providing a mean-reversion edge. Entry rule: If price breaks above the opening range high (ORH) within the first 30 minutes and then pulls back to touch VWAP with a bullish candle (close > open) and RSI(14) < 55, enter long at the close of that candle. Exit shape: Chart-stop at ORH (invalidation), TP1 at 1.5R, runner trail 20% off HWM. Regime hint: VIX < 18 (low volatility) and time between 09:45-10:30 EST.

## Mechanism
Entry: 
- Calculate opening range (OR) high (ORH) and low (ORL) from 09:30-10:00 EST (first 30 minutes).
- Wait for a break above ORH (price > ORH) within the first 30 minutes (i.e., by 10:00 EST).
- After the break, wait for a pullback to VWAP (price touches VWAP) with a bullish candle (close > open) and RSI(14) < 55.
- Enter long at the close of that candle.
Exit:
- Stop loss: chart stop at ORH (if price closes a 3-min candle above ORH, exit).
- Take profit 1: 1.5R (where R is the distance from entry to stop).
- Runner: trail stop at 20% off the high-water mark (HWM) after TP1 is hit.
